description: Defines the NetworkChangeNotifierPassive class, a subclass of NetworkChangeNotifier, which handles network change notifications on platforms like ChromeOS, Lacros, Android, and Linux. It includes methods for updating network state and internal data members for managing network info.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierPassive
classes.description: A class that listens for network change events and can be notified externally about network state changes, especially useful in sandboxed or platform-specific environments.

methods.name: OnDNSChanged
methods.description: Notify that DNS configuration has changed.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Notify that IP address has changed.

methods.name: OnConnectionChanged
methods.description: Notify that the connection type has changed.

methods.name: OnConnectionSubtypeChanged
methods.description: Notify that the connection subtype has changed.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type.

methods.name: GetCurrentMaxBandwidthAndConnectionType
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum bandwidth and connection type.
